title: Leaving My Phone Behind
sentences: I used to check my phone the moment I woke up.
Before I had even got out of bed, I had already read twenty messages.
A friend suggested that I leave it in the kitchen overnight.
The first few evenings felt strange, and almost uncomfortable.
I kept reaching for something that was not there.
After about a week I noticed that I was falling asleep a good deal more easily.
I also started reading books again, which I had not done for years.
I have not become one of those people who refuse to use a phone at all, and I never will.
I still use it constantly during the day for work.
But the hour before bed now belongs to me instead of to the screen in my hand.
